request_routes.label: Bevacizumab and biosimilars for approved non-ocular oncology indications
request_routes.routing_notes: Coverage is limited to the listed non-ocular oncology indications; all other indications are considered experimental, investigational, or unproven.
request_routes.evidence: Aetna considers bevacizumab and its biosimilars medically necessary for the non-ocular oncology indications enumerated under I. Criteria for Initial Approval.

route_guards.label: Bevacizumab is not combined with cetuximab or panitumumab
route_guards.evidence: Aetna considers bevacizumab and its biosimilars in combination with cetuximab (Erbitux) or panitumumab (Vectibix) experimental, investigational, or unproven.

section_path: II. Aetna considers bevacizumab ... in combination with cetuximab or panitumumab experimental

cluster_entry_guards.label: Bevacizumab for NSCLC is not maintenance with pemetrexed
cluster_entry_guards.evidence: Aetna considers bevacizumab and its biosimilars in combination with pemetrexed as maintenance therapy for non-squamous non-small cell lung cancer experimental, investigational, or unproven.

section_path: IV. Aetna considers bevacizumab ... in combination with pemetrexed as maintenance therapy

cluster_entry_guards.label: Bevacizumab for RCC is not combined with atezolizumab
cluster_entry_guards.evidence: Aetna considers bevacizumab and its biosimilars in combination with atezolizumab for the treatment of renal cell carcinoma experimental, investigational, or unproven.

section_path: III. Aetna considers bevacizumab ... in combination with atezolizumab for renal cell carcinoma experimental

condition_clusters.condition_label: Intestinal-type ampullary adenocarcinoma (progressive or metastatic)
condition_clusters.evidence: A. Ampullary adenocarcinoma - for treatment of intestinal-type ampullary adenocarcinoma that is progressive, or metastatic.

condition_clusters.condition_label: Appendiceal, colorectal, or anal neoplasm or carcinoma
condition_clusters.evidence: B. Appendiceal neoplasms and cancers ... and E. Colorectal cancer, including appendiceal adenocarcinoma, and anal adenocarcinoma.

condition_clusters.condition_label: Central nervous system cancers as listed
condition_clusters.evidence: C. Central nervous system (CNS) cancers - for treatment of circumscribed glioma, diffuse high-grade gliomas, glioblastoma, H3-mutated high-grade glioma, HGAP, intracranial and spinal ependymoma (excludes subependymoma), IDH mutant astrocytoma (WHO Grade 2-4), oligodendroglioma (WHO Grade 2-3), medulloblastoma, PXA (WHO Grade 2-3), primary CNS lymphoma, meningiomas, limited and extensive brain metastases, metastatic spine tumors, and primary spinal cord tumors.

condition_clusters.condition_label: Persistent, recurrent, or metastatic cervical cancer
condition_clusters.evidence: D. Cervical cancer - for treatment of persistent, recurrent, or metastatic cervical cancer.

condition_clusters.condition_label: Stage III-IV or persistent, recurrent, or metastatic endometrial carcinoma
condition_clusters.evidence: F. Endometrial carcinoma - for treatment of stage III-IV, persistent, recurrent, or metastatic endometrial carcinoma.

condition_clusters.condition_label: Unresectable or extrahepatic/metastatic hepatocellular carcinoma in combination with atezolizumab
condition_clusters.evidence: G. Hepatocellular carcinoma - for treatment of unresectable or extrahepatic/metastatic hepatocellular carcinoma when the requested medication will be used in combination with atezolizumab.

condition_clusters.condition_label: Pleural, peritoneal, pericardial, or tunica vaginalis testis mesothelioma meeting listed therapy scenarios
condition_clusters.evidence: H. Mesothelioma - for treatment of pleural, peritoneal, pericardial, or tunica vaginalis testis mesothelioma when any of the following criteria are met: (a) first-line therapy with pemetrexed plus cisplatin or carboplatin followed by single-agent bevacizumab maintenance; (b) subsequent therapy with pemetrexed plus cisplatin or carboplatin if immunotherapy was first-line; (2) induction therapy prior to surgical exploration for clinical stage I epithelioid disease with pemetrexed plus cisplatin or carboplatin; (3) subsequent therapy in combination with atezolizumab.

condition_clusters.condition_label: Recurrent, unresectable, advanced, or metastatic non-squamous non-small cell lung cancer
condition_clusters.evidence: I. Non-small cell lung cancer (NSCLC) - for treatment of recurrent, unresectable, advanced, or metastatic non-squamous NSCLC.

condition_clusters.condition_label: Epithelial ovarian, fallopian tube, primary peritoneal cancer, or malignant sex cord-stromal tumors
condition_clusters.evidence: J. Ovarian cancer/fallopian tube cancer/primary peritoneal cancer - for treatment of epithelial ovarian cancer, fallopian tube cancer, primary peritoneal cancer, and malignant sex cord-stromal tumors.

section_path: J. Ovarian cancer/fallopian tube cancer/primary peritoneal cancer

condition_clusters.evidence: II.B. CNS cancer continuation criteria are met when there is no unacceptable toxicity or disease progression, or when disease progressed on single-agent bevacizumab and carmustine, lomustine, or temozolomide is added for the specific CNS cancers.

condition_clusters.condition_label: Continuation for cervical cancer
condition_clusters.evidence: II. Continuation of Therapy - continuation criteria apply when there is no unacceptable toxicity or disease progression on the regimen.

condition_clusters.condition_label: Continuation for endometrial carcinoma

condition_clusters.condition_label: Continuation for hepatocellular carcinoma with atezolizumab
condition_clusters.evidence: II. Continuation of Therapy - no unacceptable toxicity or disease progression while on the regimen.

condition_clusters.condition_label: Continuation for mesothelioma

condition_clusters.condition_label: Continuation for non-squamous non-small cell lung cancer
condition_clusters.evidence: II.A. NSCLC continuation - no unacceptable toxicity or disease progression, or continuation in combination with erlotinib when disease is T790M-negative and there is no unacceptable toxicity.

condition_clusters.condition_label: Continuation for ovarian/fallopian tube/primary peritoneal cancer or malignant sex cord-stromal tumors
condition_clusters.evidence: II. Continuation of Therapy - requires absence of unacceptable toxicity or disease progression on the current regimen.

condition_clusters.condition_label: Continuation for renal cell carcinoma
condition_clusters.evidence: II. Continuation of Therapy - apply when no unacceptable toxicity or disease progression is present on the current regimen.

condition_clusters.condition_label: Continuation for small bowel adenocarcinoma
condition_clusters.evidence: II. Continuation of Therapy - no unacceptable toxicity or disease progression while on current regimen.

condition_clusters.condition_label: Continuation for angiosarcoma
condition_clusters.evidence: II. Continuation of Therapy - requires stability with no unacceptable toxicity or disease progression.

condition_clusters.condition_label: Continuation for solitary fibrous tumor or hemangiopericytoma
condition_clusters.evidence: II. Continuation of Therapy - requires no unacceptable toxicity or disease progression on the active regimen.

condition_clusters.condition_label: Continuation for vaginal cancer
condition_clusters.evidence: II. Continuation of Therapy - maintain therapy when there is no unacceptable toxicity or disease progression.

condition_clusters.condition_label: Continuation for vulvar cancer
condition_clusters.evidence: II. Continuation of Therapy - applies when there is no unacceptable toxicity or disease progression on regimen.

logic_profiles.label: Continuation - no unacceptable toxicity or disease progression
logic_profiles.evidence: II. Continuation of Therapy - medically necessary when there is no evidence of unacceptable toxicity or disease progression while on the current regimen.

logic_profiles.label: NSCLC continuation logic
logic_profiles.evidence: II.A. NSCLC continuation - allow reauthorization when there is no unacceptable toxicity or disease progression, or when continuing with erlotinib for T790M-negative disease with no unacceptable toxicity.

logic_profiles.label: CNS cancer continuation logic
logic_profiles.evidence: II.B. CNS cancer continuation permits reauthorization when there is no unacceptable toxicity or disease progression, or when progression on single-agent bevacizumab occurs and carmustine, lomustine, or temozolomide is added for the listed CNS cancers.

notes.parsing_notes: Parsed Aetna Clinical Policy Bulletin 0685 to capture approved non-ocular oncology indications, continuation criteria, and investigational combinations; administrative requirements and ocular indications are out of scope.
